text:
tj: noticing spike in 99p tail for inference in eu-west1-gpu-pool, started ~09:14 UTC. Grafana: https://grafana.company.internal/d/abcd/inference-latency . root cause maybe GPU throttling, saw Xid 13 in kernel logs. quick snippet:

`````
Mar 10 09:14:22 gpu-node-37 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:04:00): 13, PID 2345: GPU collapsed due to error
Mar 10 09:14:27 gpu-node-37 kernel: NVRM: GPU at 0000:04:00: Enabled CRTCs: 0
`````

infra-bot: [alert] 3 nodes reporting sustained power cap at 180W, fans below expected RPM, thermal warnings.

maria: can you paste `nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,POWER` output from one of the nodes? suspect powercap mis-config from BIOS/ILO.

kevin: grabbing output now from gpu-node-37:

`````
$ nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,POWER -i 0
GPU Current Temp : 88 C
PState : P2
Power Draw : 199.50 W
Power Limit : 200.00 W
GPU Fan Speed : 12 %
Clocks Throttle Reasons : GPU Idle, Thermal
`````

nora: 88C + fan=12% while powercap ~200W => fan PWM stuck or BMC/IPMI override. Also Xid 13 often tied to firmware/driver resets but can be induced by power throttles.

maria: schedule immediate drain of affected nodes? prefer rolling drain one at a time. @nora can you add taint `gpu=drain-required:NoSchedule` and move pods to eu-west1-burst pool?

nora: doing `kubectl drain gpu-node-37 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=15m` and `kubectl taint nodes gpu-node-37 gpu=drain-required:NoSchedule` now. moving pods to fallback pool.

kevin: quick mitigation we can try now: increase power limit and force fan to full via ipmitool (temporary):

`````
# set power limit to 250W
nvidia-smi -i 0 -pl 250
# set fan to 100% (if BMC supports)
ipmitool raw 0x30 0x30 0x01 0x00
ipmitool raw 0x30 0x30 0x02 0xff
`````

maria: hold on changing power without vendor ok, but agree to try fan PWM fix first. if BMC responds then put node into maintenance and mark for replacement if fans are dead.

infra-bot: ECC counters for gpu-node-37: correctable=12 in last hour, uncorrectable=1. Xid count=6 in last 30m.

tj: thanks. I'll update the incident doc and page traffic to dedicated-capacity. link: https://confluence.company.internal/incidents/GPU-THROTTLE-2026 .

kevin: I'm on call, can do physical swap for two suspect GPUs in rack eu-west1-r5 after biz hours if vendor can't do overnight RMA.

maria: filed hardware ticket with vendor, attached serials: GPU_SN_12345, GPU_SN_12346. ticket created #VND-9876.

nora: note for postmortem: add monitor for fan PWM vs expected RPM and runbook step to auto-taint when Xid > 3/min AND fan RPM < 20%.

tj: good. 99p latency dropped after draining gpu-node-37 and moving traffic. will keep node offline until replacement. :white_check_mark:

kevin: adding ipmi logs and sensor dump to the ticket. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks team. reopening if we see regression.
